story.text: 덕진공원 와본 적 있어요? …없으면 오늘 처음이네요.
story.reading: deok-jin-gong-won wa-bon jeog iss-eo-yo? …eobs-eu-myeon o-neul cheo-eum-i-ne-yo.
story.en: Have you been to Deokjin Park before? ...If not, today's your first time.

story.text: 이 '연못'이 여름엔 진짜 예뻐요. 지금도 나쁘지 않지만.
story.reading: i 'yeon-mos'i yeo-reum-en jin-jja ye-ppeo-yo. ji-geum-do na-ppeu-ji anh-ji-man.
story.en: This 'pond' is really pretty in summer. Though it's not bad now either.

story.text: 저기 핀 게 '연꽃'이에요. …좋아하는 것 같아서 데려왔어요.
story.reading: jeo-gi pin ge 'yeon-kkoch'i-e-yo. …jo-a-ha-neun geot gat-a-seo de-ryeo-wass-eo-yo.
story.en: Those blooming there are 'lotus flowers'. ...You seemed to like them, so I brought you here.

story.text: 이 '다리' 건너면 반대편이에요. 넘어지지 말고 천천히 와요.
story.reading: i 'da-ri' geon-neo-myeon ban-dae-pyeon-i-e-yo. neom-eo-ji-ji mal-go cheon-cheon-hi wa-yo.
story.en: Cross this 'bridge' and you're on the other side. Don't trip, take it slow.

story.text: 실은 오늘 '오후', 일부러 스케줄 비워뒀어요. …그냥, 어쩌다 보니까요.
story.reading: sil-eun o-neul 'o-hu', il-bu-reo seu-ke-jul bi-wo-dwoss-eo-yo. …geu-nyang, eo-jjeo-da bo-ni-kka-yo.
story.en: Actually, I deliberately cleared my 'afternoon' today. ...It just... happened that way, that's all.

story.text: 우리 '그림자' 봐요, 나란히 붙어 있네요. …그게 뭐 어때서요.
story.reading: u-ri 'geu-rim-ja' bwa-yo, na-ran-hi but-eo it-ne-yo. …geu-ge mwo eo-ttae-seo-yo.
story.en: Look at our 'shadows', they're side by side. ...So what if they are.

story.text: …됐고, 그냥 옆에 있어요. 이유 같은 거 묻지 말고요.
story.reading: …dwaet-go, geu-nyang yeop-e iss-eo-yo. i-yu gat-eun geo mut-ji mal-go-yo.
story.en: ...Never mind, just stay by my side. Don't ask for a reason.

words.example_en: Lotus flowers bloom fully in summer.
Cross the bridge and you'll find the park.
I like taking walks in the afternoon.
The two people's shadows are side by side.

sentences.en: Lotus flowers have bloomed in the pond.
I take a walk across the bridge.
The shadow has stretched out long.
We spend the afternoon together by the pond.
